description: Source code for menu configuration handling in a Linux kernel or similar project, including functions for managing menus, properties, dependencies, and generating help and string representations.

methods.name: menu_warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to a menu.

methods.name: prop_warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to a property.

methods.name: _menu_init
methods.description: Initializes menu state variables.

methods.name: menu_add_entry
methods.description: Adds a new menu entry for a symbol.

methods.name: menu_add_menu
methods.description: Creates a new submenu.

methods.name: menu_end_menu
methods.description: Ends the current menu context.

methods.name: rewrite_m
methods.description: Rewrites 'm' to 'm' && MODULES for conditional evaluation.

methods.name: menu_add_dep
methods.description: Adds a dependency expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: menu_set_type
methods.description: Sets the type of the current menu's symbol.

methods.name: menu_add_prop
methods.description: Adds a property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: menu_add_prompt
methods.description: Adds a prompt property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: menu_add_visibility
methods.description: Adds a visibility expression to the current menu.

methods.name: menu_add_expr
methods.description: Adds an expression property.

methods.name: menu_add_symbol
methods.description: Adds a symbol property.

methods.name: menu_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes menu structure, propagating dependencies and validating symbols.

methods.name: menu_has_prompt
methods.description: Checks if a menu has a prompt.

methods.name: menu_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a menu is empty or only contains invisible entries.

methods.name: menu_is_visible
methods.description: Determines if a menu is visible based on dependencies and symbol states.

methods.name: menu_get_prompt
methods.description: Retrieves the prompt text for a menu.

methods.name: menu_get_parent_menu
methods.description: Returns the parent menu of a given menu.

methods.name: menu_has_help
methods.description: Checks if a menu has help text.

methods.name: menu_get_help
methods.description: Retrieves help text for a menu.

methods.name: get_def_str
methods.description: Generates a string indicating where a menu was defined.

methods.name: get_dep_str
methods.description: Generates a string representation of an expression dependency.

methods.name: get_jump_key_char
methods.description: Returns a character for jump keys, weakly linked.

methods.name: get_prompt_str
methods.description: Generates a detailed string representation of a prompt, including dependencies and location.

methods.name: get_symbol_props_str
methods.description: Generates a string of symbol properties matching a specific type.

methods.name: get_symbol_str
methods.description: Generates a detailed string representation of a symbol and its properties.

methods.name: get_relations_str
methods.description: Creates a string of relations for an array of symbols.

methods.name: menu_get_ext_help
methods.description: Retrieves extended help information for a menu.
